events.title: Mount Sir Donald from Abbott Ridge
events.thought: The Navigator climbed. I waited. The photographs are, apparently, excellent.
events.photoCaption: Panoramic view from Abbott Ridge toward Mount Sir Donald, the prominent pyramid-shaped peak at center-right, with multiple glaciated summits, snowfields, and a glacier across the Glacier National Park skyline.

events.title: Loop Brook under Ross Peak
events.thought: I held the trailhead all day while The Navigator logged vertical miles — a distribution of labor I find consistently unsatisfying.
events.photoCaption: View from the habitat module at Loop Brook Campground, Glacier National Park, with a bare granite peak rising above dense spruce forest in the early morning haze.
photoNote: Today's report is filed secondhand. The Navigator handled the day's vertical work while I secured the trailhead, which is not the role I would have chosen.

Abbott Ridge was the objective. The views of Mount Sir Donald and the surrounding peaks were, by all accounts, spectacular. I have it on reliable authority that the photograph was worth the climb. I remained at elevation zero.
Camp is Site 7 at Loop Brook Campground in Glacier National Park, settled under Ross Peak at 7,621 feet.
